post.summary: Create a one-use account/installation-bound OIDC authorization nonce challenge
post.description: Account API access-token bearer required, no device headers or existing device needed. Accept schemaVersion/installationId; return schemaVersion/enrollmentId/authorizationNonce/expiresAt once. Server persists only account/installation binding, SHA-256 of ASCII nonce, createdAt, 300-second expiry and consumed status (EnrollmentChallengeRecord). No device authority is granted. At most one active challenge per account/installation, five per account; creation attempts capped at 5/account and 20/IP per rolling 300 seconds. No existing challenge invalidation; cap is 429 rateLimited with Retry-After. Required idempotency key; committed replay is 409 enrollmentConsumed without nonce, changed request is 409 idempotencyConflict. Lost 201 waits for expiry then a new key/challenge. Missing verified Entra auth_time/account mapping is 503 enrollmentUnavailable. See API.md.

201.description: One-return authorization nonce and enrollmentId, expiry at server createdAt + 300 seconds; Cache-Control no-store and no response-body replay cache.

post.summary: Consume a standard OIDC nonce challenge and fresh native ID-token proof; return a device credential once
post.description: Account API access-token bearer required; no device headers. Body enrollmentId/enrollmentIdToken is scoped enrollment proof, NEVER generic API bearer authentication. Verify ordinary signed native-client-audience ID token against server challenge/account/installation, signed nonce and fresh auth_time; no custom Entra assertion issuer/claims. Required X-Pebbi-Reauth is intent only. Optional replaceDeviceId enables explicitly reviewed same-installation confirmed-credential recovery, including the last device, with atomic old revocation/new issuance and no old-bearer-only shortcut. Committed replay is 409 enrollmentConsumed, never a secret. Full freshness, rates, pending expiry and transaction rules are in API.md.

appBearer.description: Generic API authentication validates Entra API access-token issuer, API audience, delegated scope, signature, time and account status. ID tokens NEVER satisfy bearer security. Only POST /v1/devices additionally accepts an ordinary native-client-audience ID token in enrollmentIdToken body as scoped nonce-bound fresh enrollment proof. Device-bound routes also require their exact registered device credential. Canonical account key is pinned issuer/tenant plus signed immutable oid and matching tid where provided; reject absent/unconfigured mapping. Pairwise sub stays token/audience-specific metadata, never literal cross-audience equality or email/name matching.

meteringBearer.description: Separate workload audience and application role; explicit service allowlist. End-user delegated tokens are rejected even if valid for the app API.

stripeSignature.name: Stripe-Signature
stripeSignature.description: Verify signature against raw body and configured webhook secret with timestamp tolerance; not a static API key.

deviceCredential.name: X-Pebbi-Device-Token
deviceCredential.description: Opaque backend-issued device credential; AND appBearer in the same security requirement. Lookup by account + X-Pebbi-Device-Id, compare stored SHA-256 digest in constant time and validate confirmation/revocation. Never sufficient alone.

enrollmentId.description: Server-created challenge bound to API-bearer account and exact installationId; unexpired and consumed once atomically with credential issuance.

enrollmentIdToken.description: Ordinary Entra signed native-client-audience ID token from auth-code + PKCE with server authorizationNonce, prompt=login and configured signed auth_time. Body-only enrollment proof, NEVER generic API bearer. Verify signature/iss/aud/time, signed nonce hash, same account as independent API access token via pinned issuer/tenant + immutable signed oid and matching tid where provided, not pairwise sub equality or email/name, challenge installation/expiry, auth_time >= challenge.createdAt, age <= 300 seconds and auth_time strictly after current enrollmentNotBefore. No custom purpose, assertion ID or installation claims. Actual deployment auth_time and cross-audience mapping remain external gates; see API.md.

replaceDeviceId.description: Optional exact confirmed nonrevoked device of the same account and installation, selected in explicit accessible native recovery review. Requires the same fresh challenged ID-token proof, never another working device or old bearer alone. Server atomically consumes challenge, revokes target/old sessions, advances threshold and creates new pending credential. Proof clears pre-transaction threshold; future enrollment clears advanced threshold. Without this field an active confirmed installation conflicts; an unexpired unconfirmed target cannot be replaced. See API.md for races/lost-response recovery.

RegisterDeviceRequest.description: Closed registration/replacement body. Account API access token is separately required in Authorization. No client-supplied nonce, auth_time, account mapping, approval boolean or custom issuer claim object is accepted.

deviceTokenConfirmBy.description: Server issuance + 300 seconds. First successfully authenticated device-bound REST admission confirms possession before this deadline. Unconfirmed enrollment expires and is revoked; the raw secret cannot be recovered.

RegisterDeviceResponse.description: Single 201 delivery only, never replayed from idempotency cache. Confirmed credential lasts until revocation. Lost delivery requires pending retirement then new challenge/new interactive OIDC proof. Reviewed confirmed same-installation recovery atomically revokes old device and issues a new pending device, not a recoverable old secret.

tokenBudget.description: Required property; null when verified capacity, safe clamps or estimator evidence is missing/stale. DeviceToken.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 CSPRNG bytes. Secret returned once; validate canonical decoding, never trim. Device-bound REST requires this plus matching device ID and app bearer. Persist only SHA-256 digest server-side; native Keychain only.

TokenEstimator.description: Identity/version selects a reviewed native AND gateway estimator implementation; never downloadable code or a guessed chars/token ratio. fixedOverheadTokens bounds all gateway-only instructions/wrappers. maxImageTokens is a deployment-verified upper bound per supported image (including adapter tiling); null forbids images. Estimate tool schemas, all messages/content and images separately from fixed overhead. A conservativeBound must be justified for this exact adapter/deployment.

TokenBudget.description: All quantities are tokens. Provider context capacity is deployment-verified, distinct from operator maxInputTokens/maxOutputTokens. Semantically enforce maxInputTokens + maxOutputTokens <= providerContextTokens, evidence freshness <=24h, usable input >0 and matching estimator evidence. budgetId changes on deployment, estimator, overhead, clamp, capacity or evidence revision; never expose private endpoint/deployment configuration.

authorizationNonce.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of 32 CSPRNG bytes. Send verbatim as OIDC nonce. Server stores only SHA-256 of these ASCII characters; never raw nonce in persistent caches/logs/exports. Returned once and discarded from native attempt memory on completion/cancel/expiry.

expiresAt.description: Server createdAt (UTC whole seconds) + 300 seconds. Completion must commit strictly before this time, no skew extension.

CreateEnrollmentResponse.description: One-return challenge, not device authority. No device credential in this response; no replayable nonce cache.

authorizationNonceHash.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of ASCII authorizationNonce, NOT its decoded random bytes; compare in constant time.

createdAt.description: Server UTC time truncated to whole seconds, never client-supplied. Signed auth_time must be at least this time.

expiresAt.description: createdAt + 300 seconds; row retained through this time + 60 seconds only for replay/cleanup, not proof validity.

consumed.description: Initially false; atomic compare-and-set to true in the account transaction that issues the new device credential. Rollback issues nothing; commit never reopens.

EnrollmentChallengeRecord.description: SERVER-INTERNAL challenge metadata, never a client request/response. Account from validated API access token, installation from validated create request, nonce hash/IDs/times generated by backend. These are not custom Entra claims. Exact rates, one-use semantics, revocation threshold and retention are normative in API.md.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Optional correlation UUID; invalid values rejected. Server generates one if absent and echoes it. Never authorization.

DeviceId.name: X-Pebbi-Device-Id
DeviceId.description: Public opaque device ID belonging to bearer account, verified against the independently supplied DeviceToken digest and nonrevoked record. Knowing this ID is not authentication.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID scoped to authenticated principal + method + path; canonical request hash must match on replay. See API.md for streaming and one-time token exclusions.

RecentAuth.name: X-Pebbi-Reauth
RecentAuth.description: Signals recent-auth action; server must independently require verified authentication age <= 5 minutes, never trust this header as proof.

DeviceToken.name: X-Pebbi-Device-Token
DeviceToken.description: Secret device credential, not a public identifier. Required together with app bearer and matching DeviceId on every device-bound REST request, including session minting; not sent on WebSocket upgrades.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge; do not include token internals.

Error403.description: Scope, device, recent authentication or policy denied
